history.summary: FLAG - UNCERTAIN IDENTITY: the CSV name 'Sur Sagar Lake Temple' matches no documented temple; this row is provisionally identified as the 111-ft Sarveshwar Mahadev (Shiva) statue in the middle of Sursagar Lake (Chand Talao), Vadodara. The Vadodara Mahanagar Seva Sadan built the statue 1996-2002 (sculptor Naresh Verma); Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the murti pratishtha on 12 March 2002. It was gold-plated with 17.5 kg of gold at Mahashivratri 2023 (Suvarna Sankalp Foundation / Satyam Shivam Sundaram Samiti, MLA Yogeshbhai Patel), costing ~Rs 12 crore. Height is given as 111 ft by most sources; MakeMyTrip says 120 ft (verify). Coordinates are the Sursagar Lake centre, approximate for the statue itself. It is a statue-shrine, not a conventional temple with regular darshan timings.

name: Sarveshwar Mahadev (Sursagar Lake)
town_description: Vadodara (Baroda) is a major city on the Vishwamitri river in central Gujarat, former seat of the Gaekwad rulers; known for the Laxmi Vilas Palace, Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum and a strong industrial and cultural base.

travel.airport: Vadodara Airport (~8-10 km) is the nearest; Ahmedabad is the main international gateway (~110 km).
travel.railway: Vadodara Junction is ~2-3 km from Sursagar Lake.
travel.road: Centrally located on Shree Chhatrapati Shivaji Marg, Raopura; easily reached by local transport. Boating on the lake is available.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; evenings to see the illuminated statue; Mahashivratri for the festival.
visitor_information.opening_hours: No published temple darshan timings (verify); the statue is viewed from the lake promenade. Special lighting on Saturday and Sunday evenings (per travel blog).
